headline: Weathered Expanse Shifts to Wardens; Nevish Line's Toll Mounts
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung further toward the Wardens since the last edition: five works to two Colonial there, with two more lying unclaimed, and the district remains the busiest on the board at six actions in the past two hours and fifty-three across the day, the fighting clustered about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk. The Nevish Line still stands six Warden works to two Colonial, its ground little changed, yet it is now the costliest station anywhere, near 679 Colonial and 811 Warden casualties in the past hour. Linn Mercy holds ten Colonial works to one unclaimed, with Lathair the centre of some twenty-odd actions. Marban Hollow remains four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, though its guns have fallen quiet since the small hours. Mooring County is now wholly Warden, twelve works, The Wind Hills its chief scene. Stonecradle reports heavy losses against scant ground changing hands, and Callahan's Passage carries the heaviest cumulative toll. The wider map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, Warden strength massed in the north and west.
